title: Design System: Gian Carlo Noriega Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero greetings and major personal branding only.

headline.purpose: Main section titles and categorical breaks.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase metadata, category kickers, and code tags.

shadows.name: ambient-amber
shadows.purpose: High-impact focus glow under primary CTA buttons.

motion.name: ease-physics
motion.purpose: Spring-calibrated curve for interactive hovers and state changes.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Tactile amber button for high-priority visitor conversion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f59e0b; color: #000; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d97706; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -5px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent glass button for secondary navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #e4e4e7; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Tactile Action Pill
components.description: Pill action button exceeding 44px touch target for project demo links.
components.css: .ds-action-pill { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #f4f4f5; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-action-pill:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #fcd34d; border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); }

narrative.overview: The interface embodies the refined precision of a high-end post-production mastering suite combined with the technical rigor of modern software engineering. It eschews generic developer portfolio templates and AI gradient clichés in favor of deep obsidian depth, disciplined typographic hierarchy, and warm amber illumination reminiscent of studio monitors and color-grading hardware.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Ground (#090a0f) allowing media artifacts to lead with high contrast
Cinematic Amber Accent (#f59e0b) strictly reserved for interactive moments
Glassmorphic Precision with 1px translucent borders and backdrop blur
Strict Accessibility Floor exceeding 44x44px touch targets on all viewports

rules.name: The Five-Percent Accent Rule
rules.body: Cinematic amber is used on ≤5% of any viewport. Its scarcity is what gives it authority and urgency.

rules.name: The Solid Type Rule
rules.body: Text never uses gradient fills or clipping masks. Typography is always rendered in solid, uncompromised contrast.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Integrity Rule
rules.body: Animated headings must split by words first, ensuring personal names and brand terms never wrap mid-character across screen sizes.

rules.name: The Ambient Light Rule
rules.body: Diffuse ambient colored light glows are locked behind -z-10 with low opacity (<0.05) to protect readability.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 44x44px bounding box on all interactive controls.
Do reserve the amber accent for primary moments of interaction and key achievements.
Do provide immediate tactile feedback on all buttons.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion across all custom animations.
donts: Don't use decorative gradient text or purple/cyan AI glow tells.
Don't use low-contrast text (e.g., dark gray on black).
Don't trap users in modals or mobile drawers without clear dismiss mechanisms.
Don't break names or technical titles across individual letters.
